{{Quote|These scrapes and dents and scorch marks tell a story. ''Your'' story. Where you've been. What you've done. Who you ''are''.|Syke|<ref name="The Enemy Within" />}}
'''Syke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was part of a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]], where he was betrayed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by his fellow clone [[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Why is it always ''me''?|Syke|<ref name="The Enemy Within" />}}
Syke was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]],<ref name="The Enemy Within" /> bred on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Clone Databank" /> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Syke was one of millions of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] who made up the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], though he differentiated himself by painting his [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with yellow lightning bolts on the shoulders and shaving his hair into a mohawk. At some point, he received a scar across the left side of his mouth.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

Early in the war, he participated in a battle aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] were down, and they were descending into a [[Star/Legends|sun]], as well as having been boarded by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. While Syke's fellow clones fell back to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], Syke attempted to get the ship working again as his helmet filled with sweat. Two of the droidekas rolled past him, ignoring him in their efforts to destroy the escape pods. Syke shot at them, gaining their attention, then threw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] at the pair, catching them right before their shields activated. The droids were destroyed, showering Syke with fiery pieces, one of which melted his armor on the left side of his chest. He opted not to have the armor fixed or replaced, believing that the damage done to a clone's armor only served to tell his individual story.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

===Mission to Oznek===
{{Quote|Hey Ghost... Has anyone told you you're kind of a jerk?|Syke, to Ghost|<ref name="The Enemy Within" />}}
Later in 22 BBY, Syke was sent on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oznek]], under the direct command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]]. By this time, he was close friends with another clone named [[Cutter (clone trooper)|Cutter]]. While flying above the planet's forest aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], Syke, Cutter, and [[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]] mocked their new sergeant for cleaning his armor and weapons. Banks admonished Syke for his behavior, threatening him with being forced to write an in-depth report on regulation protocols. Shortly after that, their ship came under heavy fire. The area was supposed to be unoccupied by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate forces]], but they discovered a large [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], which blasted them out of the sky.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

[[File:Sykedeath.png|thumb|left|250px|Syke, betrayed and killed by his brother, Ghost]]
The LAAT crashed, killing the pilot and several other clones on impact. Syke escaped from the wreckage via a hatch, only to find hundreds of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] bearing down on them. Wielding his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], Syke and the other clones fought off the attacking droids while trying to protect their wounded and burying their dead. Eventually, the waves of unending [[Droid/Legends|droids]] ceased, and the remaining seven clones covered their tracks by detonating a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Setting up camp in the woods, Syke attempted to repair and use a [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]] to no avail. After [[Crazy Legs]] asked and Syke urged him on, Banks demonstrated the origin of his nickname&mdash;an unusual ability to calculate angles and bank his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts off of objects without losing their strength and still hitting his target. They were then contacted via [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] by Commander Kishpaugh after Syke got the array working. Kishpaugh informed them that there was a [[Command center|droid command center]] twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away, and that they were to destroy it despite their losses. He then ordered Syke and the rest of the clone troopers from the shelter, speaking with Banks alone.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

Syke and the others moved out before sunrise, leaving Crazy Legs behind, as he'd broken one of his legs in the crash. They moved through the forest, encountering dangerous terrain and creature everywhere, and lost another clone, who was eaten by an animal. As they traveled, Syke told a war story from early in the conflict, then asked Ghost for a story of his own, but the older clone demurred. Cutter, leading the way, then brought the others' attention to an ancient city in ruins. The clones remarked that their [[scanner]]s hadn't picked up any trace of the large settlement, and suddenly found themselves surrounded by [[Toma]], the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of Oznek. With their hands bound, the clones readied themselves for death after the Toma's leader ordered their executions, but were discovered and attacked by droids once again. Banks asked the Toma to cut their bonds so they could fight together, and the Toma did so. Syke and the others picked up their weapons and held back the droids, but Cutter realized that Banks had to complete their mission. He told the sergeant to take Syke and Ghost, while he and the other surviving clone trooper held off the droids. Banks said that he wouldn't leave Cutter behind, but when Cutter pointed out that the Toma couldn't be allowed to live either, Syke and the others fled.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

They made their way to the facility that Kishpaugh had targeted, and once there Ghost sniped the two guards outside, allowing them to sneak inside. They made their way through the corridors, encountering little resistance, which Banks would later remark they should have found suspicious. Once inside the main part of the facility, Banks ordered Syke and Ghost to spread out and look for signs of Separatist technology. Syke quickly noticed that something was awry and that the facility looked nothing like the way it had been described. He was then shot in the back by Ghost, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

The mission turned out to be a falsehood from the beginning, the circumstances and details manufactured by Kishpaugh and Ghost, both of whom were planning to defect to the Confederacy for different reasons. The price of their escape from the Republic was creating a pretense for war on Oznek&mdash;namely, blowing up a "droid command center" that was really a [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]]. Banks managed to foil the plan, killing Ghost and capturing Kishpaugh.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />
